targetTexts.4: The sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
targetTexts.5: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
targetTexts.6: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
targetTexts.7: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites, and the Rodanites.
targetTexts.8: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
targetTexts.9: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
targetTexts.10: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who began to be a mighty one on the earth.
targetTexts.11: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites, the Anamites, the Lehabites, the Naphtuhites,
targetTexts.12: the Pathrusites, the Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorites.
targetTexts.13: And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
targetTexts.14: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
targetTexts.15: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
targetTexts.16: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.
targetTexts.17: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram. The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
targetTexts.18: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
targetTexts.19: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.
targetTexts.20: And Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
targetTexts.23: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
targetTexts.24: So from Shem came Arphaxad, Shelah,
targetTexts.28: The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael.
targetTexts.29: These are their genealogies: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
targetTexts.31: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.
targetTexts.32: The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
targetTexts.33: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All of these were Keturah’s sons.
targetTexts.34: Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
targetTexts.35: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
targetTexts.36: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz; and by Timna, Amalek.
targetTexts.37: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
targetTexts.38: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
targetTexts.39: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.
targetTexts.40: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
targetTexts.41: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
targetTexts.42: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
targetTexts.43: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites: Bela son of Beor. His city was named Dinhabah.
targetTexts.44: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
targetTexts.45: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
targetTexts.46: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith.
targetTexts.47: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
targetTexts.48: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the Euphrates reigned in his place.
targetTexts.49: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.
targetTexts.50: When Baal-hanan died, Hadad reigned in his place. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
targetTexts.51: Then Hadad died. Now the chiefs of Edom were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
targetTexts.54: Magdiel, and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
